"""Standalone verification of the Q.deconstruct fix (issue #32548).

Replicates the assertions of the upstream updated tests
(django commit 00b0786de5) without modifying the repo's tests:
  - updated tests/queries/test_q.py::test_deconstruct / _negated
  - new test_deconstruct_boolean_expression (Exists child)
  - the issue's original reproducer
"""
import django
from django.conf import settings

settings.configure(
    INSTALLED_APPS=["django.contrib.contenttypes", "django.contrib.auth"],
    DATABASES={},
)
django.setup()

from django.contrib.auth import get_user_model
from django.db.models import Exists, F, Q

# --- updated test_deconstruct ---
q = Q(price__gt=F("discounted_price"))
path, args, kwargs = q.deconstruct()
assert path == "django.db.models.Q", path
assert args == (("price__gt", F("discounted_price")),), args
assert kwargs == {}, kwargs

# --- updated test_deconstruct_negated ---
q = ~Q(price__gt=F("discounted_price"))
path, args, kwargs = q.deconstruct()
assert args == (("price__gt", F("discounted_price")),), args
assert kwargs == {"_negated": True}, kwargs

# --- test_deconstruct_boolean_expression (Exists child, non-subscriptable) ---
tagged = get_user_model().objects.filter(username="jim")
q = Q(Exists(tagged))
_, args, kwargs = q.deconstruct()
assert args == (Exists(tagged),), args
assert kwargs == {}, kwargs

# --- the issue's original reproducer (used to raise TypeError) ---
print(Q(Exists(get_user_model().objects.filter(username="jim"))).deconstruct())

# --- multi-child / connector / nested behavior unchanged ---
q = Q(x=1, y=2)
assert q.deconstruct() == ("django.db.models.Q", (("x", 1), ("y", 2)), {}), q.deconstruct()
q = Q(x=1) | Q(y=2)
assert q.deconstruct() == ("django.db.models.Q", (("x", 1), ("y", 2)), {"_connector": "OR"}), q.deconstruct()
q = Q(Q(x=1))
assert q.deconstruct() == ("django.db.models.Q", (Q(x=1),), {}), q.deconstruct()

# --- reconstruct round-trips ---
for q in [Q(price__gt=F("discounted_price")), ~Q(price__gt=F("discounted_price")), Q(Exists(tagged))]:
    path, args, kwargs = q.deconstruct()
    assert Q(*args, **kwargs) == q, q

print("ALL UPDATED-TEST ASSERTIONS PASS")
